sources.title: Quran 54:17 (Surah Al-Qamar), Quran.com
sources.supports: States that Allah has made the Quran easy to remember, with the question of whether anyone will be mindful.

sources.title: Quran 73:4 (Surah Al-Muzzammil), Quran.com
sources.supports: Instructs the reader to recite the Quran properly in a measured way, supporting slow, careful recitation.

sources.title: Quran 20:114 (Surah Ta-Ha), Quran.com
sources.supports: Tells the Prophet not to rush to recite before the revelation is properly conveyed and to pray My Lord, increase me in knowledge.

sources.title: Sahih al-Bukhari 5027, Sunnah.com
sources.supports: The Prophet said the best among you are those who learn the Quran and teach it.

sources.title: Sahih al-Bukhari 5031, Sunnah.com
sources.supports: The one who knows the Quran by heart is like the owner of tied camels: if he keeps them tied he controls them, if he releases them they run away.

sources.title: Sahih al-Bukhari 5032, Sunnah.com
sources.supports: The Prophet urged believers to keep reciting the Quran because it escapes from the hearts of men faster than camels from their ropes.

sources.title: Sahih Muslim 790a, Sunnah.com
sources.supports: Says it is wrong to say I forgot such a verse, since one is made to forget it, and tells believers to keep refreshing their recitation of the Quran.

sources.title: Sahih Muslim 798a, Sunnah.com
sources.supports: The one who recites skillfully is with the noble angels, and the one who stumbles while finding it difficult has a double reward.

sources.title: Sunan Abi Dawud 1464, Sunnah.com
sources.supports: It will be said to the companion of the Quran to recite and rise, reciting as in the world, for his rank is at the last verse he recites; graded hasan sahih.

review.notes: Read each retrieved page text. Quran verses 54:17, 73:4 and 20:114 and hadith in Bukhari 5027, 5031, 5032 and Muslim 790a and 798a, plus Abu Dawud 1464 with its grade, match the paraphrases. No fixed completion time is claimed; Islamful reader features (repeat count, hide/reveal, bookmarks, no recitation checking) were confirmed in components/quran/QuranReader.tsx.

claim_checks.claim: Allah made the Quran easy to remember
claim_checks.explanation: The page text of 54:17 states exactly that, followed by the question of whether anyone will be mindful.

claim_checks.claim: The Quran asks for measured recitation
claim_checks.explanation: The 73:4 text says to recite the Quran properly in a measured way.

claim_checks.claim: Do not rush and ask for increase in knowledge
claim_checks.explanation: The 20:114 text says do not rush to recite before it is properly conveyed and to pray My Lord, increase me in knowledge.

claim_checks.claim: Best are those who learn and teach the Quran
claim_checks.explanation: The Bukhari 5027 page quotes this saying of the Prophet.

claim_checks.claim: Quran owner compared to owner of tied camels
claim_checks.explanation: The Bukhari 5031 page contains the tied camels example about keeping or releasing them.

claim_checks.claim: Quran escapes faster than camels from ropes
claim_checks.explanation: The Bukhari 5032 Arabic text and Reference confirm the camels-and-ropes comparison.

claim_checks.claim: Saying I forgot a verse is criticised; keep refreshing recitation
claim_checks.explanation: The Muslim 790a Arabic text criticises saying I forgot a verse and commands istidhkar of the Quran.
The Muslim 798a Arabic text says the one who stumbles in it with difficulty has two rewards.

claim_checks.claim: Rank is at last verse recited, graded hasan sahih
claim_checks.explanation: The Abu Dawud 1464 page says the rank is at the last verse recited and shows the Hasan Sahih grade.
